summary: Blended invoice missing per-workload rate memo for mixed streaming+batch usage
description: Issue summary: Customer BrightScale.ai received March invoice with a single blended line item labeled 'multi-workload blended rate' but there is no memo breakdown showing how streaming vs batch embeddings usage were apportioned or which rate tiers applied. Impact: customer cannot reconcile costs against internal chargebacks and is requesting detailed memo lines or provisional credit. Environment: production billing run for billing period 2026-02-01 to 2026-02-28 covering hosted and dedicated fallbacks across us-east and eu-west. Customer says invoice total matches expectation but line-item explanation is insufficient for their finance team.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Identify org ID 98765432 for BrightScale.ai in billing UI. 2) Generate invoice #INV-2026-03-BS-98765432 in admin console. 3) Observe line items: single 'multi-workload blended rate' line with blended tag and no per-workload memo. 4) Compare usage export for period and note separate streaming token counts and batch embedding token counts; reconciliation expected to show per-workload rates applied.
logs: billing-run: run_id=2026-03-02-07z, invoice_job_id=job-8f3b21, postback_processor=v2.14.3, blend-decider=v1.9.0. Exported usage file: s3://billing-exports/2026/02/brightscale/usage.csv (attached). Error logs: invoice-generator did not throw errors; memo-builder logged INFO 'applied blended policy' but WARN 'memo-fragment-suppressed: no-diff-threshold' at 2026-03-02T07:12:44Z.
comments: 2026-03-10 10:22 - Support (Ava Chen): Opened ticket after customer support call. Customer requests either a) full memo lines showing per-workload rates and quantities, or b) provisional credit until we provide an audit. Provided them with exported usage CSV as interim artifact.

2026-03-10 11:05 - Billing Ops (Noah Kim): Investigating the invoice-generator memo-fragment suppression flag — looks like a recent threshold change collapsed small-line deltas into the blended bucket. I will fetch the decision logs.

2026-03-11 09:40 - Engineering (Marcus Patel): Found the blend-decider change in PR github.com/redwood-inference/billing/PR#2899; a threshold adjustment was deployed to reduce line noise. It suppressed memo fragments when per-workload delta < 0.5% of invoice total. For BrightScale the batch embed delta was 0.32% and got suppressed.

2026-03-11 14:05 - Support (Ava Chen): Customer unhappy with suppression rule; they want per-workload detail regardless of delta for enterprise tier. Requested escalation to apply exception and reissue invoice memo lines.

2026-03-12 08:30 - Billing Ops (Noah Kim): Prepared a manual audit CSV with per-workload attribution and suggested provisional credit equal to 0.32% of blended line (rounded) while we re-run memo generator with override.
investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: recent change to memo-fragment suppression threshold (PR#2899) collapsed small per-workload lines into single blended line for cleanliness. Confirmed by searching decision logs in blend-decider for org 98765432: 'suppressed_fragments=[batch_embed]' with ratio=0.0032. Audit of usage export shows batch embedding tokens=1,204,320 (0.32% cost contribution) and streaming tokens=378,123,442. The customer is enterprise and has contract clause requiring line-itemization for chargebacks; suppression should not apply to enterprise. Roots: conditional exception flag for enterprise was not being applied because org tag normalization changed during tag migration (tag=enterprise->enterprise-v2).
resolution: Workaround applied: Billing Ops ran a manual memo re-generation for invoice INV-2026-03-BS-98765432 with override 'force_itemize=true'. Updated invoice notes attached and provisional credit of $18.72 applied to customer's account (corresponds to suppressed fragment). Permanent fix: engineering to backfill tag normalization mapping and add a unit test to ensure enterprise exception honours both legacy and new tags. PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/billing/PR#2923 (fix + test). Rollout plan: hotfix merged and scheduled for 2026-03-13 morning billing window. Follow-up actions: reissue corrected invoice PDF and email to BrightScale finance, confirm acceptance of provisional credit, and update confluence memo explaining suppression thresholds and enterprise exceptions.
next_steps: Apply tag-normalization hotfix to blend-decider (PR#2923) and deploy to staging for smoke tests
Re-run memo-generator for Feb billing and reissue corrected invoice PDF to customer
Confirm customer acceptance of provisional credit and close ticket
Add retrospective note to #support-billing and Confluence explaining the change and exception rules
